name: Dirección General del Catastro, INSPIRE Buildings (ATOM, per municipality)
license: Free of charge; credit the D. G. del Catastro (Ministerio de Hacienda) as author and owner
coverage: Spain except the foral cadasters (Basque Country, Navarra); updated twice a year

fields.footprint_m2: area of the building footprint polygon
fields.floors_above: numberOfFloorsAboveGround of the building parts (footprint-weighted mean)
fields.floors_below: numberOfFloorsBelowGround of the building parts (footprint-weighted mean)
fields.built_area_m2: value where officialAreaReference = grossFloorArea (official); else sum over parts of part area x numberOfFloorsAboveGround
